summary: This competitor sells realistic Sikh and Hindu paintings as home wall prints, with prices from about $60 up to $2,500. They focus on Gurus, warriors, and gods and re-sell hits as new editions. Your biggest opening is what they skip: Sikh women stories, Punjabi village life, modern abstract and resin home items, and cheap starter prints under $25.

actionable_insights.title: Add a cheap starter print
actionable_insights.action: List one small print at $14 to $22 from your Guru Nanak or women series on Etsy and your site.
actionable_insights.why: Competitor starts at $59.99, so a cheaper print wins gift buyers.

actionable_insights.title: Make a Sikh Women shop group
actionable_insights.action: Make one group called Sikh Women and put your Mai Bhago, Mata Gujri and empowerment art in it.
actionable_insights.why: Competitor has Warrior and Saint groups but no women group.

actionable_insights.title: Copy their home wording
actionable_insights.action: Change 3 titles to add for your home, like Guru Nanak painting print for your home.
actionable_insights.why: Almost every competitor title uses for Your Home to get home buyers.

actionable_insights.title: Make a gift-ready listing
actionable_insights.action: Add the word gift and one gift-wrap photo to your Golden Temple or Guru print.
actionable_insights.why: Competitor uses gift wording but has nothing under $59.99.

actionable_insights.title: Tell one painting story
actionable_insights.action: Write a short 5-sentence post about one village life or goddess painting and link your print.
actionable_insights.why: Competitor has only 2 blog pages, so a simple story helps you stand out.
